summary: the noentropy cases, which require the random devices, getrandom, the salt mint, passwd and Dropbear's key generator to refuse while the generator is untrusted, against three faults in the kernel and one in the salt mint; etude-guest makes its boot's token with GRND_INSECURE where /dev/urandom refuses, so a getrandom that refuses GRND_INSECURE leaves every case without its program, incomplete at its boot stage's bound

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 musl-programs utils && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/musl/saltnoent tests/musl/passwdmusl utils/sbin/passwd
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run noentropy 'run: noentropy: PASS'

faults.name: urandom
faults.summary: the random devices answer a read while the generator is untrusted, which also lets dropbearkey make a key

faults.name: insecure
faults.summary: getrandom refuses GRND_INSECURE while the generator is untrusted

lines: guest.noentropy.rngprobe on i686: incomplete: it ran past its stage bound
guest.noentropy.keygennoent on i686: incomplete: it ran past its stage bound

faults.name: mint
faults.summary: a salt mint that fills the salt with zeros when getrandom fails
